instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, the notebook goes on the pile of books, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

# Observe and get edge pinch grasp candidate for the notebook
obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
cands = grasp_candidates("cyan_notebook")

# Select a reachable edge pinch candidate that is free below
chosen = None
for c in cands:
    if c.get("edge_free_below", False):
        app = c["approach"]
        fax = c.get("finger_axis", [0, 0, 1])
        # Check IK for approaching position (4 cm back along approach)
        back_dist = 0.05
        x_pre = c["x"] - app[0] * back_dist
        y_pre = c["y"] - app[1] * back_dist
        z_pre = table_z + c["height"]
        res = solve_ik(x_pre, y_pre, z_pre, approach=app, finger_axis=fax)
        if res["reachable"]:
            chosen = c
            break

if chosen is None:
    # Fallback to first edge pinch candidate with either vertical finger_axis
    for c in cands:
        app = c["approach"]
        for fax in ([0, 0, 1], [0, 0, -1]):
            x_pre = c["x"] - app[0] * 0.05
            y_pre = c["y"] - app[1] * 0.05
            z_pre = table_z + c["height"]
            res = solve_ik(x_pre, y_pre, z_pre, approach=app, finger_axis=fax)
            if res["reachable"]:
                c["finger_axis"] = fax
                chosen = c
                break
        if chosen is not None:
            break

app = chosen["approach"]
fax = chosen["finger_axis"]
z_grip = table_z + chosen["height"]

# Open gripper and move to pre-grasp position
open_gripper()
# Move high first to avoid collisions
move_gripper(chosen["x"] - app[0] * 0.08, chosen["y"] - app[1] * 0.08, table_z + 0.25, approach=app, finger_axis=fax, path="line")
# Descend to grip height
move_gripper(chosen["x"] - app[0] * 0.05, chosen["y"] - app[1] * 0.05, z_grip, approach=app, finger_axis=fax, path="line")
# Move forward along approach onto the notebook edge
move_by(dx=app[0] * 0.055, dy=app[1] * 0.055, dz=0)
close_gripper()

# Lift with held notebook
move_by(dz=0.20)

# Move above book_pile
pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
pile_x, pile_y = pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1]
pile_top_z = obs["table_z"] + pile["top_height"]

# Transport above pile maintaining orientation
move_gripper(pile_x, pile_y, pile_top_z + 0.10, approach=app, finger_axis=fax, path="line")

# Lower onto the pile
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(0.12)
go_home()
check("cyan_notebook", "book_pile")
